    def _wait_for_port(host: str, port: int, timeout_s: int = 30) -> None:
        """Attend que le port soit ouvert (polling 1s)."""
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                s = socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=1)
                s.close()
                return
            except (ConnectionRefusedError, OSError):
                time.sleep(1)

    def test_workflows_install_via_known_patterns(self) -> None:
        """Chaque workflow qui installe des deps Python doit utiliser un pattern connu."""
        # Patterns autorises (au moins l'un doit etre present si le workflow installe).
        valid_patterns = [
            r"pip install\s+-r\s+requirements",
            r"pip install\s+-e\s+\.",
            r"pip install\s+\.",
            r"pip install\s+--upgrade",  # pip lui-meme, neutre
        ]
        # Workflows totalement exempts (pas Python ou pas de pip install).
        exempt_filenames = {
            "labeler.yml",
            "release-drafter.yml",
            "stale.yml",
            "dependabot-auto-merge.yml",
            "pr-title-lint.yml",
            "link-check.yml",
            "gitleaks.yml",
            "scorecard.yml",
            "claude.yml",
            "actionlint.yml",
        }
    
        failures: list[str] = []
        for wf in _list_workflows():
            if wf.name in exempt_filenames:
                continue
            text = wf.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if "pip install" not in text:
                # Workflow Python sans pip install : OK (ex: smoke EXE pur).
                continue
            ok = any(re.search(p, text) for p in valid_patterns)
            if not ok:
                failures.append(wf.name)

"\U0001f7e1" : "\U0001f535";\\n    // Si le message contient deja le count en prefixe ("22 film(s) ..."), on ne l\\'ajoute pas.\\n    const labelStr = it.label;\\n    const messageStartsWithCount = it.count != null && /^\\\\d/.test(labelStr.trim());\\n    const prefix = it.count != null && !messageStartsWithCount ? `${it.count} ` : "";\\n    const filterHint = it.filter_hint ? `<span class="accueil-suggestion-hint">${escapeHtml(String(it.filter_hint))}</span>` : "";\\n    return `\\n      <li class="accueil-suggestion-row ${sevClass}" data-target-route="${escapeHtml(it.route)}">\\n        <span class="accueil-suggestion-dot" aria-hidden="true">${sevDot}</span>\\n        <span class="accueil-suggestion-text"><strong>${escapeHtml(prefix + labelStr)}</strong>${filterHint}</span>\\n        <button type="button" class="v5-btn v5-btn--ghost accueil-suggestion-action" data-accueil-action="open-insight" data-target-route="${escapeHtml(it.route)}" aria-label="Ouvrir cette suggestion">\u2192</button>\\n      </li>\\n    `;\\n  }).join("");\\n  const moreLink = totalItems > _MAX_SUGGESTIONS\\n    ? `<div class="accueil-actions"><button type="button" class="v5-btn v5-btn--ghost" data-accueil-action="view-all-suggestions">\u2192 Voir toutes (${totalItems})</button></div>`\\n    : "";\\n  return `\\n    <section class="accueil-section accueil-suggestions" aria-labelledby="accueil-suggestions-title">\\n      <h2 id="accueil-suggestions-title" class="accueil-section-title">\u26a0\ufe0f ${totalItems} Points \xe0 traiter</h2>\\n      <ul class="accueil-suggestion-list">${rows}</ul>\\n      ${moreLink}\\n    </section>\\n  `;\\n}\\n\\n/* Phase 5 (spec 05 \xa76 Activit\xe9 r\xe9cente) \u2014 Timeline visuelle 7 jours.\\n * Affiche une bande horizontale avec 7 colonnes (J-6 \xe0 J) ; chaque run est\\n * une "bullet" color\xe9e selon son statut, empil\xe9e verticalement dans sa\\n * colonne. Le hover affiche un tooltip natif (title) avec les d\xe9tails.\\n */\\nconst _TIMELINE_DAYS = 7;\\nconst _WEEKDAY_SHORT_FR = ["Dim", "Lun", "Mar", "Mer", "Jeu", "Ven", "Sam"];\\n\\n/** Retourne le statut derive (APPLIED/PARTIAL/ERROR/DONE) pour un run. */\\nfunction _deriveRunStatus(r) {\\n  const errors = Number(r.errors_count || 0);\\n  const applied = Number(r.applied_rows || 0);\\n  const total = Number(r.total_rows || 0);\\n  const explicit = String(r.status || "").toUpperCase();\\n  if (explicit) {\\n    if (explicit === "APPLIED" || explicit === "DONE" || explicit === "PARTIAL" || explicit === "ERROR") {\\n      return explicit;\\n    }\\n  }\\n  if (errors > 0) return "ERROR";\\n  if (applied > 0 && total > 0 && applied >= total) return "APPLIED";\\n  if (applied > 0 && total > 0 && applied < total) return "PARTIAL";\\n  return "DONE";\\n}\\n\\nfunction _statusBulletClass(status) {\\n  const s = String(status || "").toUpperCase();\\n  if (s === "APPLIED") return "accueil-timeline-bullet--applied";\\n  if (s === "PARTIAL") return "accueil-timeline-bullet--partial";\\n  if (s === "ERROR") return "accueil-timeline-bullet--error";\\n  return "accueil-timeline-bullet--done";\\n}\\n\\n/** Construit les 7 colonnes (J-6 \u2192 J) avec les runs groupes par jour calendaire. */\\nfunction _bucketRunsByDay(runs, now) {\\n  const ref = now || new Date();\\n  const todayStart = new Date(ref.getFullYear(), ref.getMonth(), ref.getDate());\\n  const cols = [];\\n  for (let i = _TIMELINE_DAYS - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {\\n    const day = new Date(todayStart.getTime() - i * _ONE_DAY_MS);\\n    cols.push({\\n      date: day,\\n      label: i === 0 ? "Auj." : (i === 1 ? "Hier" : _WEEKDAY_SHORT_FR[day.getDay()]),\\n      dayNum: day.getDate(),\\n      runs: [],\\n    });\\n  }\\n  const list = Array.isArray(runs) ? runs : [];\\n  for (const r of list) {\\n    const tsSrc = r.started_ts != null ? new Date(Number(r.started_ts) * 1000) : (r.started_at ? new Date(r.started_at) : null);\\n    if (!tsSrc || Number.isNaN(tsSrc.getTime())) continue;\\n    const rDay = new Date(tsSrc.getFullYear(), tsSrc.getMonth(), tsSrc.getDate());\\n    const diff = Math.round((todayStart.getTime() - rDay.getTime()) / _ONE_DAY_MS);\\n    if (diff < 0 || diff >= _TIMELINE_DAYS) continue;\\n    const colIdx = _TIMELINE_DAYS - 1 - diff;\\n    cols[colIdx].runs.push({ ...r, _ts: tsSrc });\\n  }\\n  // Trie les runs intra-colonne par heure croissante (le plus ancien en bas).\\n  for (const c of cols) c.runs.sort((a, b) => a._ts.getTime() - b._ts.getTime());\\n  return cols;\\n}\\n\\nfunction _renderRecentActivity(runs) {\\n  const list = Array.isArray(runs) ? Un\\n    // toISOString() le convertit en UTC -> sur fuseau negatif (ou proche de\\n    // minuit positif) data-day-iso renvoie le jour calendaire precedent et\\n    // casse les selecteurs e2e. On construit l\\'ISO YYYY-MM-DD localement.\\n    const _y = c.date.getFullYear();\\n    const _mm = String(c.date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");\\n    const _dd = String(c.date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");\\n    const _dayIsoLocal = `${_y}-${_mm}-${_dd}`;\\n    return `\\n      <div class="accueil-timeline-day ${isToday ? "is-today" : ""}" data-day-iso="${escapeHtml(_dayIsoLocal)}">\\n        <div class="accueil-timeline-bullets">${bullets}</div>\\n        <div class="accueil-timeline-day-label">\\n          <span class="accueil-timeline-day-name">${escapeHtml(c.label)}</span>\\n          <span class="accueil-timeline-day-num">${escapeHtml(String(c.dayNum))}</span>\\n        </div>\\n      </div>\\n    `;\\n  }).join("");\\n  // Legende des couleurs (3 statuts principaux pour la timeline).\\n  const legend = `\\n    <ul class="accueil-timeline-legend" aria-label="L\xe9gende des statuts">\\n      <li><span class="accueil-timeline-bullet accueil-timeline-bullet--applied" aria-hidden="true"></span>Appliqu\xe9</li>\\n      <li><span class="accueil-timeline-bullet accueil-timeline-bullet--partial" aria-hidden="true"></span>Partiel</li>\\n      <li><span class="accueil-timeline-bullet accueil-timeline-bullet--error" aria-hidden="true"></span>Erreur</li>\\n      <li><span class="accueil-timeline-bullet accueil-timeline-bullet--done" aria-hidden="true"></span>Termin\xe9</li>\\n    </ul>\\n  `;\\n  return `\\n    <section class="accueil-section accueil-activity" aria-labelledby="accueil-activity-title">\\n      <h2 id="accueil-activity-title" class="accueil-section-title">Activit\xe9 r\xe9cente (7 jours)</h2>\\n      <div class="accueil-timeline-7d" role="img" aria-label="Timeline des runs sur les 7 derniers jours">\\n        ${colsHtml}\\n      </div>\\n      ${legend}\\n      <div class="accueil-actions">\\n        <button type="button" class="v5-btn v5-btn--ghost" data-accueil-action="view-history">\u2192 Voir l\\'historique complet</button>\\n      </div>\\n    </section>\\n  `;\\n}\\n\\nfunction _extractScanProgress(payload) {\\n  // Le backend get_dashboard retourne active_run_id si un scan est en cours.\\n  // Pour cette PR 3.1-C, on se contente d\\'un check basique. Le polling\\n  // complet (re-fetch /run/get_status toutes les 2s) viendra Phase 3.1-D.\\n  if (!payload) return { active: false };\\n  const activeRunId = payload.active_run_id || (payload.run_info && payload.run_info.status === "running" ? payload.run_info.run_id : null);\\n  if (!activeRunId) return { active: false };\\n  const ri = payload.run_info || {};\\n  return {\\n    active: true,\\n    run_id: activeRunId,\\n    total: ri.total_rows || ri.total || 0,\\n    current: ri.current_index || 0,\\n    phase: ri.phase || "running",\\n    phase_label: ri.phase_label || null,\\n    eta_min: ri.eta_min != null ? ri.eta_min : null,\\n  };\\n}\\n\\nfunction _resolveLatestRun(payload) {\\n  // get_dashboard ne retourne PAS un champ run_info dedie. On lit le flag canonique `_has_tmdb_api_key`\\n  // (pr\xe9sence r\xe9elle de la cl\xe9), avec repli sur la valeur si elle n\\'est pas masqu\xe9e.\\n  const tmdbKey = typeof s.tmdb_api_key === "string" ? s.tmdb_api_key.trim() : "";\\n  const hasTmdbKey = s._has_tmdb_api_key === true || tmdbKey !== "";\\n  const tmdbEnabled = s.tmdb_enabled !== false; // par defaut on suppose enabled\\n  const tmdbMissing = !tmdbEnabled || !hasTmdbKey;\\n\\n  const secondaryMissing = [];\\n  if (!s.jellyfin_enabled && !(typeof s.jellyfin_api_key === "string" && s.jellyfin_api_key.trim())) {\\n    secondaryMissing.push("Jellyfin");\\n  }\\n  if (!s.plex_enabled && !(typeof s.plex_token === "string" && s.plex_token.trim())) {\\n    secondaryMissing.push("Plex");\\n  }\\n  if (!s.radarr_enabled && !(typeof s.radarr_api_key === "string" && s.radarr_api_key.trim())) {\\n    secondaryMissing.push("Radarr");\\n  }\\n\\n  let html = "";\\n  if (tmdbMissing) {\\n    html += `\\n      <div class="accueil-setup-banner accueil-setup-banner--alert" role="alert">\\n        \u26a0\ufe0f Configuration incompl\xe8te : TMDb n\\'est pas configur\xe9.\\n        <a href="#/parametres#integrations">Configurer maintenant \u2192</a>\\n      </div>\\n    `;\\n  }\\n  if (secondaryMissing.length > 0) {\\n    html += `\\n      <div class="accueil-setup-banner accueil-setup-banner--info" role="status">\\n        \u2139\ufe0f Int\xe9grations optionnelles non configur\xe9es : ${escapeHtml(secondaryMissing.join(", "))}.\\n        <a href="#/parametres#integrations">Configurer \u2192</a>\\n      </div>\\n    `;\\n  }\\n  return html;\\n}\\n\\n// Fix audit 2026-05-24 (v1.5.2) : Vague E \u2014 carte discrete "Nouvelle version\\n// disponible" sous le hero, visible uniquement si update detectee. Log technique + message UX clair.\\n      const technicalMsg = (_payload.message || _payload.error || "").toString();\\n      if (technicalMsg) console.error("[accueil] start_plan refused:", technicalMsg);\\n      _showErrorBanner(container, "Impossible de d\xe9marrer l\\'analyse. Tout va bien.</p>\\n      </section>\\n    `;\\n  }\\n  // Phase 5 spec \xa74 : 3 suggestions max (top s\xe9v\xe9rit\xe9), lien "Voir toutes" si >3.\\n  const _MAX_SUGGESTIONS = 3;\\n  const totalItems = items.length;\\n  const rows = items.slice(0, _MAX_SUGGESTIONS).map((it) => {\\n    const sev = it.severity;\\n    const sevClass = sev === "danger" ? "is-danger" : sev === "warning" ? "is-warning" : "is-info";\\n    const sevDot = sev === "danger" ? "\U0001f534" : sev === "warning" ? "\U0001f7e1" : "\U0001f535";\\n    // Si le message contient deja le count en prefixe ("22 film(s) ..."), on ne l\\'ajoute pas.\\n    const labelStr = it.label;\\n    const messageStartsWithCount = it.count != null && /^\\\\d/.test(labelStr.trim());\\n    const prefix = it.count != null && !messageStartsWithCount ? `${it.count} ` : "";\\n    const filterHint = it.filter_hint ? `<span class="accueil-suggestion-hint">${escapeHtml(String(it.filter_hint))}</span>` : "";\\n    return `\\n      <li class="accueil-suggestion-row ${sevClass}" data-target-route="${escapeHtml(it.route)}">\\n        <span class="accueil-suggestion-dot" aria-hidden="true">${sevDot}</span>\\n        <span class="accueil-suggestion-text"><strong>${escapeHtml(prefix + labelStr)}</strong>${filterHint}</span>\\n        <button type="button" class="v5-btn v5-btn--ghost accueil-suggestion-action" data-accueil-action="open-insight" data-target-route="${escapeHtml(it.route)}" aria-label="Ouvrir cette suggestion">\u2192</button>\\n      </li>\\n    `;\\n  }).join("");\\n  const moreLink = totalItems > _MAX_SUGGESTIONS\\n    ? `<div class="accueil-actions"><button type="button" class="v5-btn v5-btn--ghost" data-accueil-action="view-all-suggestions">\u2192 Voir toutes (${totalItems})</button></div>`\\n    : "";\\n  return `\\n    <section class="accueil-section accueil-suggestions" aria-labelledby="accueil-suggestions-title">\\n      <h2 id="accueil-suggestions-title" class="accueil-section-title">\u26a0\ufe0f ${totalItems} Points \xe0 traiter</h2>\\n      <ul class="accueil-suggestion-list">${rows}</ul>\\n      ${moreLink}\\n    </section>\\n  `;\\n}\\n\\n/* Phase 5 (spec 05 \xa76 Activit\xe9 r\xe9cente) \u2014 Timeline visuelle 7 jours.\\n * Affiche une bande horizontale avec 7 colonnes (J-6 \xe0 J) ; chaque run est\\n * une "bullet" color\xe9e selon son statut, empil\xe9e verticalement dans sa\\n * colonne. Le hover affiche un tooltip natif (title) avec les d\xe9tails.\\n */\\nconst _TIMELINE_DAYS = 7;\\nconst _WEEKDAY_SHORT_FR = ["Dim", "Lun", "Mar", "Mer", "Jeu", "Ven", "Sam"];\\n\\n/** Retourne le statut derive (APPLIED/PARTIAL/ERROR/DONE) pour un run. */\\nfunction _deriveRunStatus(r) {\\n  const errors = Number(r.errors_count || 0);\\n  const applied = Number(r.applied_rows || 0);\\n  const total = Number(r.total_rows || 0);\\n  const explicit = String(r.status || "").toUpperCase();\\n  if (explicit) {\\n    if (explicit === "APPLIED" || explicit === "DONE" || explicit === "PARTIAL" || explicit === "ERROR") {\\n      return explicit;\\n    }\\n  }\\n  if (errors > 0) return "ERROR";\\n  if (applied > 0 && total > 0 && applied >= total) return "APPLIED";\\n  if (applied > 0 && total > 0 && applied < total) return "PARTIAL";\\n  return "DONE";\\n}\\n\\nfunction _statusBulletClass(status) {\\n  const s = String(status || "").toUpperCase();\\n  if (s === "APPLIED") return "accueil-timeline-bullet--applied";\\n  if (s === "PARTIAL") return "accueil-timeline-bullet--partial";\\n  if (s === "ERROR") return "accueil-timeline-bullet--error";\\n  return "accueil-timeline-bullet--done";\\n}\\n\\n/** Construit les 7 colonnes (J-6 \u2192 J) avec les runs groupes par jour calendaire. */\\nfunction _bucketRunsByDay(runs, now) {\\n  const ref = now || new Date();\\n  const todayStart = new Date(ref.getFullYear(), ref.getMonth(), ref.getDate());\\n  const cols = [];\\n  for (let i = _TIMELINE_DAYS - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {\\n    const day = new Date(todayStart.getTime() - i * _ONE_DAY_MS);\\n    cols.push({\\n      date: day,\\n      label: i === 0 ? "Auj." : (i === 1 ? "Hier" : _WEEKDAY_SHORT_FR[day.getDay()]),\\n      dayNum: day.getDate(),\\n      runs: [],\\n    });\\n  }\\n  const list = Array.isArray(runs) ? runs : [];\\n  for (const r of list) {\\n    const tsSrc = r.started_ts != null ? new Date(Number(r.started_ts) * 1000) : (r.started_at ? new Date(r.started_at) : null);\\n    if (!tsSrc || Number.isNaN(tsSrc.getTime())) continue;\\n    const rDay = new Date(tsSrc.getFullYear(), tsSrc.getMonth(), tsSrc.getDate());\\n    const diff = Math.round((todayStart.getTime() - rDay.getTime()) / _ONE_DAY_MS);\\n    if (diff < 0 || diff >= _TIMELINE_DAYS) continue;\\n    const colIdx = _TIMELINE_DAYS - 1 - diff;\\n    cols[colIdx].runs.push({ ...r, _ts: tsSrc });\\n  }\\n  // Trie les runs intra-colonne par heure croissante (le plus ancien en bas).\\n  for (const c of cols) c.runs.sort((a, b) => a._ts.getTime() - b._ts.getTime());\\n  return cols;\\n}\\n\\nfunction _renderRecentActivity(runs) {\\n  const list = Array.isArray(runs) ? Un\\n    // toISOString() le convertit en UTC -> sur fuseau negatif (ou proche de\\n    // minuit positif) data-day-iso renvoie le jour calendaire precedent et\\n    // casse les selecteurs e2e. On construit l\\'ISO YYYY-MM-DD localement.\\n    const _y = c.date.getFullYear();\\n    const _mm = String(c.date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");\\n    const _dd = String(c.date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");\\n    const _dayIsoLocal = `${_y}-${_mm}-${_dd}`;\\n    return `\\n      <div class="accueil-timeline-day ${isToday ? "is-today" : ""}" data-day-iso="${escapeHtml(_dayIsoLocal)}">\\n        <div class="accueil-timeline-bullets">${bullets}</div>\\n        <div class="accueil-timeline-day-label">\\n          <span class="accueil-timeline-day-name">${escapeHtml(c.label)}</span>\\n          <span class="accueil-timeline-day-num">${escapeHtml(String(c.dayNum))}</span>\\n        </div>\\n      </div>\\n    `;\\n  }).join("");\\n  // Legende des couleurs (3 statuts principaux pour la timeline).\\n  const legend = `\\n    <ul class="accueil-timeline-legend" aria-label="L\xe9gende des statuts">\\n      <li><span class="accueil-timeline-bullet accueil-timeline-bullet--applied" aria-hidden="true"></span>Appliqu\xe9</li>\\n      <li><span class="accueil-timeline-bullet accueil-timeline-bullet--partial" aria-hidden="true"></span>Partiel</li>\\n      <li><span class="accueil-timeline-bullet accueil-timeline-bullet--error" aria-hidden="true"></span>Erreur</li>\\n      <li><span class="accueil-timeline-bullet accueil-timeline-bullet--done" aria-hidden="true"></span>Termin\xe9</li>\\n    </ul>\\n  `;\\n  return `\\n    <section class="accueil-section accueil-activity" aria-labelledby="accueil-activity-title">\\n      <h2 id="accueil-activity-title" class="accueil-section-title">Activit\xe9 r\xe9cente (7 jours)</h2>\\n      <div class="accueil-timeline-7d" role="img" aria-label="Timeline des runs sur les 7 derniers jours">\\n        ${colsHtml}\\n      </div>\\n      ${legend}\\n      <div class="accueil-actions">\\n        <button type="button" class="v5-btn v5-btn--ghost" data-accueil-action="view-history">\u2192 Voir l\\'historique complet</button>\\n      </div>\\n    </section>\\n  `;\\n}\\n\\nfunction _extractScanProgress(payload) {\\n  // Le backend get_dashboard retourne active_run_id si un scan est en cours.\\n  // Pour cette PR 3.1-C, on se contente d\\'un check basique. 0);\\n      const rejected = Number(_runInfo.rejected ?? 0);\\n      const total = Number(_runInfo.total ?? 0);\\n      return `\\n        <div class="traitement-stats">\\n          ${_renderStat("Valid\xe9s", validated)}\\n          ${_renderStat("Rejet\xe9s", rejected)}\\n          ${_renderStat("En attente", Math.max(0, total - validated - rejected))}\\n        </div>\\n      `;\\n    }\\n    case "doublons":\\n      return `\\n        <div class="traitement-stats">\\n          ${_renderStat("Groupes de doublons", _runInfo.duplicatesGroups)}\\n        </div>\\n      `;\\n    case "apply":\\n      return `\\n        <div class="traitement-stats">\\n          ${_renderStat("Appliqu\xe9s", _runInfo.applied)}\\n          ${_renderStat("Restant", Math.max(0, _runInfo.total - _runInfo.applied))}\\n        </div>\\n      `;\\n    default:\\n      return "";\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n/* --- Etape 1 : Analyse (spec \xa73.1) --- */\\n\\nfunction _renderAnalyseStep() {\\n  const isRunning = _runStatus?.running;\\n  const idx = _runStatus?.idx || 0;\\n  // Fix audit 2026-06-08 medium : utiliser strictement _runStatus.total\\n  // pour le calcul de la barre de progression pendant le scan. self = <test_release_hygiene.ReleaseHygieneTests testMethod=test_no_personal_strings_in_repo>

    def test_no_personal_strings_in_repo(self) -> None:
        """Detecte les fuites PII : chemins Windows perso, NAS, base d'etat
        precedente. On evite de chercher le bare "blanc" qui matche aussi
        "bruit blanc" (audio FR), "carte blanche", etc. — on traque les
        vrais marqueurs de leak (chemin Users\\..., adresse mail, NAS path).
        """
        repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        allowed_exts = {".py", ".md", ".txt", ".spec", ".html", ".js", ".css"}
        # 'audit' = dossier de prompts d'orchestration parallele qui contient
        # legitimement des chemins de worktrees (.claude/worktrees/...). Pas du code prod.
        skip_dirs = {".git", ".venv", ".venv313", "build", "dist", "packages", "__pycache__", "manual", "audit"}
        skip_files = {"_BACKUP_patch_before.txt", "_BACKUP_patch_after.txt", "test_release_hygiene.py"}
    
        # Les fragments sont assembles a runtime pour que le fichier de test
        # lui-meme ne matche pas (sinon ce serait recursif).
        user_login = "".join(["bl", "anc"])
        forbidden_tokens = [
            # Chemin Windows perso: c:\users\blanc, /users/blanc/, users\blanc
            "users\\" + user_login,
            "users/" + user_login,
            "users\\\\" + user_login,
            # Email perso
            user_login + ".thomas@",
            # NAS UNC perso
            "".join(["\\\\", "omv", "\\", "media", "\\", "films"]),
            # Ancien nom du dossier d'etat (leak base v1)
            "".join(["tri_", "films_", "state"]),
        ]
    
        offenders = []
        for path in repo_root.rglob("*"):
            if not path.is_file():
                continue
            if path.suffix.lower() not in allowed_exts:
                continue
            if path.name in skip_files:
                continue
            parts_lower = {part.lower() for part in path.parts}
            if parts_lower.intersection(skip_dirs):
                continue
    
            try:
                content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                content = path.read_text(encoding="latin-1", errors="ignore")
    
            content_l = content.lower()
            for token in forbidden_tokens:
                if token in content_l:
                    offenders.append(f"{path}: {token}")
                    break
    
        if offenders:
            details = "\n".join(offenders[:40])
>           self.fail(f"Forbidden strings found:\n{details}")

self = <test_rest_security.RateLimiterHttpIntegrationTests testMethod=test_rate_limiter_returns_429_after_5_failures>

    def test_rate_limiter_returns_429_after_5_failures(self) -> None:
        """FIX DEFINITIF 2026-06-07 : 127.0.0.1 est desormais exempte du
        rate-limiter (saturation par 401 silents du _safeBearer cote front
        quand le token contient un codepoint non-ASCII). Le scenario fonctionnel
        ("apres N echecs -> bloque") reste couvert par les tests unitaires
        `RateLimiterUnitTests` (qui utilisent une IP non-locale "10.0.0.1").
        Ici on verifie le NOUVEAU contrat : meme avec le compteur sature,
        127.0.0.1 (loopback desktop pywebview) re;coit 401 et JAMAIS 429.
        """
        # 1. Pre-remplit le rate limiter pour 127.0.0.1 (defensif : le filtre
        # cote handler doit court-circuiter is_blocked avant meme de regarder).
        for _ in range(6):
            self.server._rate_limiter.record_failure("127.0.0.1")
        self.assertTrue(self.server._rate_limiter.is_blocked("127.0.0.1"))
    
        # 2. Une requete HTTP depuis 127.0.0.1 -> doit retourner 401, pas 429
        conn = HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", self.port, timeout=5)
        try:
            conn.request(
                "POST",
                "/api/get_settings",
                body=b"{}",
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer wrong"},
            )
            resp = conn.getresponse()
            status = resp.status
            resp.read()
        except (ConnectionAbortedError, ConnectionResetError):
            self.fail("Le serveur a coupe la connexion : localhost ne doit pas etre rate-limite")
        finally:
            conn.close()
>       self.assertEqual(

            401,

        )
